rearEnvelope.topology: V-folded airmail back with kraft shoulders; no horizontal top band

mouthLip.topology: paper-textured central kraft V sharing its base with the rear apex and remaining visible below every state card

pocketStage.scaling: Rear, mouth lip, front pocket, cards, and Memo use one shell width and one uniform scale. The 402 pt viewport uses a 342 pt shell; wider phones cap at 360 pt.

rule: The rear layer, visible V mouth lip, front pocket, state card, and contextual Memo are one open-envelope coordinate system. The tip must be visible between card and pocket; both kraft shoulders must connect to narrow airmail rails; no horizontal airmail band may appear above the card; no layer may be replaced by a whole-screen screenshot.
